以下 SQL 語句的目的是什麼？
CREATE VIEW V1 AS
SELECT M1.MID, COUNT(M1.MID) AS REFERRAL
FROM MEMBER M1, MEMBER M2
WHERE M1.MID = M2.REFER
GROUP BY M1.MID
